dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-section toward a sharp posterior point at the visible peduncle region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity consistent across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple parallel linear light-colored rake marks visible on the left lateral and central dorsal planes.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge creating a central axis of shadow and highlight disruption.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks and superficial scarring distributed across the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface.
